newsitem.title: USA: Excel says Ottumwa pork plant closed Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Excel says Ottumwa pork plant closed Tuesday.

text.p: Firefighters late Monday continued to douse smoldering insulation at Excel Corp's Ottumwa, Iowa, hog slaughtering and pork plant, which Excel officials said will be closed Tuesday.

Fire broke out at the plant's loading facility late Sunday forcing the plant to be closed Monday. The cause of the blaze was still under investigation, said Larry Strong, captain at Ottumwa Fire Department.
Excel spokesman Mark Klein said it is not known when the plant, which employs 1,300 people, will reopen.
"It's all speculation. They just don't know," he said regarding the plant's reopening.
Excel is a division of Cargill Inc.
There have been no reported deaths or injuries in the blaze and no damage or loss estimates have been compiled, fire and Excel officials said.
Klein said hogs normally brought to the Ottumwa plant, which can slaughter 9,600 head a day, will be diverted to the company's Beardstown, Ill., or Marshall, Mo., plants.
The Marshall plant can slaughter 6,000 head a day and Beardstown 16,000, Klein said.
